item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NLPRSD
Issued at 10:15 PM 02 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cagayan(Aparri, Allacapan, Camalaniugan, Lasam, SantoNiño, Alcala, Amulung, Iguig, Solana, TuguegaraoCity), #Isabela(Cabagan, Tumauini and SanPablo) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Cagayan(Baggao, Gattaran, Peñablanca, LalLo, SantaTeresita, Buguey) and #Isabela(Maconacon) which may persist within 30 mins to 1 hour and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 37 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 37 FINAL #NLPRSD
Weather System: Northeast Monsoon (Amihan)
Issued at 05:00 AM 02 November 2026

All Rainfall Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides, mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
